src/agent_runtime/execution/artifact_context.py

Python · Tier A

Describe where a native execution attempt writes its outputs and how receipts identify those outputs later. environment builds target-shell path variables; provenance records either Gateway artifact-workspace URIs or legacy physical paths. Run, Activity and receipt identities preserve output versions through retries and reconciliation; these helpers do not create or read files.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
environment 22 Build output-directory environment variables for a native run and optional Activity/receipt attempt. Hash run identity, select target path syntax and reuse an already captured artifact environment; receipts separate retry outputs. Return an empty mapping outside a native run. This function describes paths without creating directories or collecting files.
provenance 55 Describe the retained output namespace and selected target for a receipt. Artifact-workspace- capable Gateways receive logical workspace URIs and conversation scope; legacy paths use the environment's concrete run/Activity directories. Preserve receipt identity as the output version.

src/agent_runtime/execution/authorization.py

Python · Tier A

Combine structural safety, user permission rules and exact owner/resource consent before an adapter executes. authorize returns an ExecutionAuthorization receipt with captured scope and decision provenance; permission_metadata projects safe trace fields. The module records policy assessments but does not ask the user, supply credentials or execute work.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

authorize 100 Combine structural safety, effective permission rules, exact unsafe approval and task-scoped resource consent into an ExecutionAuthorization. Disabled guards record their assessment while allowing their own layer; they do not rewrite the structural safety decision. Capture routing/scope and policy provenance without executing the tool, requesting approval or creating credentials.

Python · Tier A

Resolve exact receipt values into tool inputs while preserving run/conversation scope and binding provenance. resolve_bindings checks recorded source quality through the accepted guard policy, then reads the authoritative store and applies JSON Pointer without replaying producers. BINDINGS_SCHEMA is model-visible runtime data and stays unchanged; BindingAuthorityUnavailable identifies missing internal preflight authority.

Store lookup always enforces scope; duplicate input names and invalid pointers reject. Return resolved arguments plus original binding provenance without mutating the caller's proposal or executing the producer again.

src/agent_runtime/execution/config.py

Python · Tier A

Define NativeExecutionConfig, the validated settings passed into execution adapters. It centralizes target routing, workspace boundaries, retention limits, foreground deadlines, database/parameter options and terminal behavior. Pydantic rejects unknown settings and invalid bounds; configuration alone does not authorize tool execution.

src/agent_runtime/execution/context.py

Python · Tier A

Separate durable execution-target data from borrowed runtime services.

Responsibilities

  • Copy only target fields into persisted jobs/recovery and preserve borrowed service identity when retargeting.

Boundaries

  • Tool contexts are not snapshots; adding a client/store/callback cannot silently persist it.

Lifecycle

  • Snapshot allowed fields recursively, reject invalid machinery and replace machine-local fields during target binding.

State

  • Snapshots detach nested data; target switching retains non-target service objects without invoking copy hooks.

Security

  • Cycles, non-string mapping keys and non-data objects raise an internal contract fault without exposing their values.

Collaborators

  • gateway_metadata defines environment fields; runtime_faults owns internal error identity.

Public surface

  • data_snapshot copies plain data; target_snapshot(s) restricts fields; bind_target retains borrowed services.

Python · Tier A

Locate and protect the controller signing identity used by Gateway pairing and outbound authentication. ensure_controller_identity serializes key creation/loading, caches unchanged private keys and rejects loss or corruption after initialization. Identity files are per-user state, independent of the checkout and conversation repositories.

Cache by inode, modification time and size, repair Unix key permissions, and reject a missing key after initialization rather than silently changing identity. Its facts feed UI/receipt diagnostics, not execution evidence.

src/agent_runtime/execution/effects.py

Python · Tier A

Classify concrete Shell and Python effects using deterministic structural proofs.

Responsibilities

  • Describe mutation/read effects and expose component read proofs from shared Shell facts.

Boundaries

  • Classification grants no permission or resource capacity; opaque programs remain unproven.

Lifecycle

  • Execution preflight classifies submitted code. Resource admission reuses parsed component facts and the same wrapper, environment, path and redirection restrictions.

State

  • Classification facts are ephemeral; callers own persisted effect descriptors and receipts.

Security

  • Executable code and literal data have distinct roles. Unknown nested code cannot acquire read-only status merely from the outer executable or a model-supplied label.

Collaborators

  • shell_syntax.py owns parsing; shell_operations.py owns executable/argv operation families.

Public surface

  • classify_shell_effect/classify_python_effect describe effects; shell_read_components proves parsed constituents within their original Shell context without reparsing their argv.

Without the text 'subprocess', unmatched source receives a medium-confidence read label. This is not a complete Python side-effect proof and does not replace sandbox, authorization or runtime receipts.

src/agent_runtime/execution/engine.py

Python · Tier A

Execute authorized capability invocations and preserve truthful outcome receipts.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve invocation context/bindings, validate schemas, evaluate safety/authority and execute the registered adapter.

Boundaries

  • The model loop selects work; this engine does not interpret user intent or declare whole- task completion. Gateway transport and external permissions remain independent boundaries.

Lifecycle

  • Preflight resolves exact invocation facts before effects; execution returns actual result/metadata for durable receipt assembly and further model decisions.

State

  • Engine configuration and result-store references are process-owned; per-invocation context carries target/authority facts. Selected targets must not inherit controller-local roots.

Security

  • Permission, capability, unsafe-action, credential and target checks apply at their own enforcement points. Transport/protocol uncertainty must not be rewritten as non-execution.

Collaborators

  • authorization.py grants execution; native_safety.py classifies invocation effects; gateway_client.py reaches the selected host; result_store.py retains execution data.

Public surface

  • ExecutionEngine exposes preflight and capability execution to native operations; adapters consume validated context rather than raw browser authority.

src/agent_runtime/execution/gateway_client.py

Python · Tier A

Carry target execution requests over verified Gateway transports and validate returned

Responsibilities

  • Compose inbound HTTP/outbound Gateway requests for execution and related file/terminal/job operations, preserving target identity and completion facts.

Boundaries

  • Transport success is not task success. Policy admission belongs to ExecutionEngine; process/service semantics belong to gateway_core.

Lifecycle

  • Use invocation context to select a target/transport, send a bounded request and normalize the actual remote response into the execution receipt contract.

State

  • Per-context TLS route selection uses ContextVar; configuration and lazily accessed Gateway stores supply identity metadata. Remote jobs/sessions retain server-owned lifetimes.

Security

  • Credential delivery requires safe verified transport; redirect handling must not forward credentials. Malformed completion outcomes raise protocol uncertainty rather than claiming non-execution.

Collaborators

  • gateway_transport.py supplies authenticated openers; outbound_gateway.py supplies reverse transport; gateway_core/process_outcome.py validates outcome facts.

Public surface

  • GatewayClient is the controller adapter boundary; response validators retain stdout/stderr, exit state, executed truth and truncation separately.

src/agent_runtime/execution/invocation.py
